defaultPolicy: Preserve every existing key unless a documented migration rule says otherwise.

rules.contract: Keep the key and configured class string; aliases remain direct and are not translated between themes.
Normalize legacy KodiCMS facade strings to first-party SleepingOwl facades after kodicms/laravel-assets is removed.

rules.reason: The aliases exposed a third-party HTML builder for markup now owned by package Blade views.
rules.fallback: No runtime fallback; update direct application usages during the major-version upgrade.
rules.timeline: Removed in the current major refactor together with spatie/laravel-html.
rules.contract: Render links, mailto anchors, selects, textareas, files and checkboxes with native Blade markup.
Keep the key, default type and backend behavior. bootstrapDirectory remains an app/Admin path and is unrelated to CSS Bootstrap.

Keep the PHP/config surface while native modules and the DataTables 3 engine replace the legacy implementation. dt_autoupdate_interval is now expressed in seconds. Incompatible raw DataTables 1 options are listed in docs/modernization/data-table-options.md.
Keep ADMIN_DEV_ASSETS and sleeping_owl.dev_assets; select the complete prebuilt production or development manifest profile.
Keep server-facing PHP formats and convert them inside the Air Datepicker adapter without exposing vendor options as the stable API.
Keep upload validation/storage behavior while Vue 3 islands and native transport replace jQuery/Dropzone integration.
Keep visible behavior and config keys; implement with modern browser APIs and no jQuery plugin.

Keep template as the selector key, publish template.default plus the template.themes name-to-class map, resolve only the selected theme, retain the former class-string as a runtime fallback, adapt legacy TemplateDefault, and allow an external provider to register ready assets through ThemeRegistry.
Keep the key and pass its value to the selected theme unchanged. Users continue to provide theme-specific classes directly; no semantic class resolver is introduced.
Keep editor selection and nested vendor configuration. Keys without current consumers remain preserved until a separate editor audit proves they can be deprecated.
Preserve currently unused CDN settings until a separate editor audit proves they can be deprecated or removed.

legacyKeys.reason: The replacement key was introduced before the frontend modernization, but long-lived published configs still use the old name.
legacyKeys.fallback: When enable_editor is absent, copy the configured show_editor value at provider registration.
legacyKeys.timeline: Deprecated in 13.x, supported throughout 13.x, and removable no earlier than 14.0.
legacyKeys.contract: When enable_editor is absent, normalize show_editor to enable_editor and emit a deprecation notice for the major migration window.
Add the existing implicit default to package defaults; old configs may omit it and continue using the runtime fallback.

plannedKeys.contract: Validated optional color sets --soa-sidebar-bg; null uses the selected theme default without a frontend rebuild.
